description: This file contains a shell script that implements a test suite for verifying git status behavior related to ignored files and directory statuses. It defines various test cases for different ignore configurations and checks the git status output accordingly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output to actual output.
